en: "I'm counting on you for that Rolfan~!"{w}
"ROLFAAAAAN!!"{w}
note: Her cry on seeing the flower; name stretched as in the source.

en:
"With this, I've become a perfect beauty of an enchantress!
Ufufu, I'll seduce this whole forest!{w}But before that--"{w}{p}"I have to thank you all.{w}Wait just a sec...{w}...Hup, there we go. Will this do?"{w}{p}"Here you go!"{w}
note: bi-youjo = beautiful + enchantress (her glossary position is 'spider enchantress'). She hands over an item here.

en: "Let's meet again! Bye-bye!"{w}
Taranti went off, moving in something like a skip.{w}
Goblin

note: Source writes G.P. with dots; project convention GP.

en: Dig through the trash?

"All right, dig away!{w}Root through it like the shameless scavengers
you are, till you've had your fill!!"{w}
note: asamashiku = shamelessly / wretchedly, kept as an insult.

en: You picked up an item from the trash.{w}
You couldn't pick up any trash.{w}
note: Literal; probably the no-room / nothing-found result.

en: Dig through some more?

"You don't have enough money!
What are you thinking, you?!"{w}
"No money, no trash!{w}Get lost!"{w}
"Man, it STINKS, though!{w}It stinks so bad I could cry-y-y!!"{w}{p}"Hey, how about you take this thing off my hands?!{w}If this keeps up, I'm gonna die!!"{w}
note: kore = an unnamed smelly item handed over next row.

en: "No returns! Go dump it somewhere!{w}No, wait, don't dump it! It'll just end up back here!{w}Anyway, I gave it to you, so it's yours! Bleuuurgh"{w}
"What, you can't carry it?!{w}Damn it... Bleuuurgh"{w}
note: mochikirenai = inventory full.

en: Rolfan flowers are in bloom.{w}
There's nothing here now.{w}
There's a half-rotted signpost.{w}

note: Sign drawn with * borders as in the source; ASCII space padding only approximates the box in a proportional font. Check in-game. Nerid no Shicchitai -> Nerid Marshlands (glossary).

en: Lunea's Voice

"Somebody~~~
he-e-elp meeee~~~"{w}
???{w}{p}Lunea's voice is coming from under your feet...???{w}

A kobold, a lizardman and an orc
are enjoying some Sweet Ginger.{w}
Orc

"This here's Sweet Ginger.
Go on, have a lick."{w}
Lizardman
"Lemme see?{w}*lick*...{w}D-DELICIOUS!!!"{w}
Kobold
"M-me too! Me too!"{w}
"You ain't getting any!!!"{w}
"Dammit, if only I'd drawn the lot on the right back then!!"{w}
note: They drew lots (kuji) for the ginger; see 2689/2691.

en:
"And then, you know that fish we grilled earlier?
If you put this on it like so..."{w}
"What is that smell?! I-it's irresistible!"{w}
"Try eating them together~"{w}
note: Source has a stretched vowel (tabete mi-); rendered with ~.
shinuru: archaic/comic form of 'die'.

en:
"Aaaargh, dammit!
DAMMIIIT!!{w}...Huh? Who are you guys?"{w}
"Rare to see adventurers come this deep into the wilds."{w}
"Hah, hah... S-so goooood~..."{w}

"Oi oi oi!{w}I'm already in a foul mood from being denied
my share, y'hear!!"{w}{p}"And anyway, why's there gotta be a winner and a loser?!{w}Two winners and everybody's happy, right?!"{w}
note: o-azuke kuratte = being made to wait like a dog for a treat. Atari/hazure = winning/losing lot. Accuracy: o-azuke kuratte here = being kept from the treat (he lost the draw for the ginger, 2673), not literally told to wait; 'told to sit and wait' implied someone ordered him.

en: "Then there'd be no point in drawing lots."{w}
"I got it! If I turn you guys into ingredients..."{w}
"Mmph... mmph-mmph..."{w}
note: Chewing noises.

en: "Seriously? Omnivore meat tastes awful, you know?"{w}
note: zasshoku = omnivore; the party (humans etc.).

en: "Don't care! I'll eat 'em!{w}Right now I could eat anything!!"{w}
note: ii! = 'fine / don't care'.

en: "Gwoh?! D-dammit!!"{w}
"Can't be helped. Shall we scram..."{w}
"So... goo... aheh, aheh..."{w}
note: Trails off: u...ma... (umai) then dazed laughter.

en: You scattered the monsters.{w}

Looking around, you found some Sweet Ginger
that hadn't been picked yet.{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained Sweet Ginger.{w}

note: Sign box as in the source; space padding approximate in a proportional font, check in-game.
Dead adventurer's gender is not settled in this slice ('they'); slice 037 calls them kare (he).

en: Slay it?
Cerberus
"GRAAAAAAHHH...!!"{w}

Letting out a terrible death cry,
the Cerberus collapsed onto the adventurer's corpse.{w}
"Hey, looks like we were a little late, huh?"{w}
note: ??? speaker; one of the trio that appears next.

en: Suspicious adventurers appeared before you.{w}
note: Plural: three of them speak next.

en: Suspicious Mage

note: Sarcasm; go-shujin-sama = the Cerberus's master, the dead adventurer.

en: Suspicious Samurai

"Yet it seems they have robbed us of our prize,
have they not?"{w}
note: de gozaru (archaic samurai speech) rendered with stiff formal English.

en: Suspicious Knight

"That's why I said we should have dealt with it ourselves
the moment we put the request in with Walmitt."{w}
note: Walmitt (glossary). Object of shimatsu read as the Cerberus: the trio posted the bounty, and the mage answers that killing it themselves would look suspicious.

en:
"Heh heh. That would only have made people suspicious.{w}Besides, these folks have yet to report
the job as done. In other words..."{w}

"If we kill them here, the reward is ours.
That is what you mean, is it not?"{w}

note: dashite kita monster = the Cerberus the traitor summoned (slice 037 confirms he was a summoner).

en:
"What that one did hardly deserves so grand
a name as betrayal.{w}Merely a weak heart that could not dye itself fully black."{w}
"Save your prattle for later.{w}Come, let us be done with them quickly."{w}

"Between adventurers, you must have been ready
for a fight like this, surely?{w}...Now, be so good as to die!!"{w}
note: shinde morau = 'I'll have you die'; polite-menacing.

en: "I never thought...{w}we would be... cut down in return..."{w}
note: kaeriuchi = beaten by the ones you attacked.

en: You routed the adventurers who attacked you.{w}
"Grrrrrr..."{w}

The Cerberus understood that you meant no harm,
but it still hasn't let its guard down.{w}
note: sen'i ga nai = no will to fight.
Walmitt-san: honorific dropped.

en:
"...I see. Then why not join us
in slaying this Cerberus?"{w}
